description: Semantic contract edges for the impact proof-cone selector (developer-velocity epic V4a). Production paths declare the contracts they own; tests declare the contracts they exercise. Changing a contract-owning path selects every test claiming that contract. Unknown or undeclared contracts fail closed. This manifest is EXPLICIT and hand-curated; static dependency and coverage relationships are generated and live elsewhere. Every owner/test path must exist in the tree (directory prefix or file); dead edges are a contract defect.

wit-world-interface.description: The WIT world/component interface shape; every WASM service consumer depends on it.

message-envelope.description: Inter-node message envelope/codec and transport contract.

partition-topology.description: Partition topology, split/merge, and placement contracts.

replica-operation-state.description: Replica-operation state machine and terminal-CAS contract.

sql-grammar.description: SQL grammar and statement parser contract.

quest-solver-ledger.description: Solver event log, Quest store, and landing/verification contract.
